name: KIC 4756681
description: A red-clump giant burning helium in its core in the Kepler field, 11.6 solar radii and 1.66 solar masses, weighed by its oscillations.

radius.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4756681 (Gold): Radius (Mosser scale, solar radii) 11.6332 +/- 0.2159

mass.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4756681 (Gold): Mass (Mosser scale, solar masses) 1.657 +/- 0.0681

temperature.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4756681 (Gold): APOGEE effective temperature (K) 4810.194 +/- 45.9236

gravity.source: Pinsonneault et al. (2025), ApJS 276, 69 (APOKASC-3), table4, KIC 4756681 (Gold): Asteroseismic log g 2.5287 +/- 0.0041

color.reason: The star lies in the Galactic plane hundreds to thousands of parsecs away, where interstellar dust reddens its spectra, and the color routes do not remove it; APOGEE measured its temperature

text.card: A red-clump giant in the Kepler field, 12 times the Sun's width, weighed by its starquakes.
text.introduction: Its oscillations give 1.66 solar masses and 11.6 solar radii; APOGEE spectra give 4,810 K at its surface.
